title: One Life
description: One Life, One World, One Player at a Time !
body: **One Life** is a small-scale social experiment. There is just one shared world that never resets; only one player can access it at a time, and you have just one life. When you die, you are banned from the server and the next player picks up where you left off. There are virtually no rules, just no cheating and be fair to others.
